summary: From the four middle blocks alone (no embeddings, no unembedding, no forward passes), Claude Opus 5.5 named the training language in 5/15 clean runs (Python 0/5; Romaji 0/5; English 5/5). Copying-head identification: mean F1 0.70 against the measured induction head of each model, with the top measured head picked in ≥2/3 attempts for 3/3 languages. Pre-registered verdict (9 runs): partial; same with all 15 runs. 15 of 15 language answers were 'English' (a default guess, so a correct 'English' is not evidence of reading the weights). No run was flagged as a no-forward-pass violation. API cost $20.96.

table.caption: Clean runs only; grading pre-registered in experiments/exp3/GRADING.md. Ground truth: induction score (unigram-sampled random characters, repeated) ≥ 0.3; previous-token score ≥ 0.3. Precision is averaged over runs that named at least one head.
